question: What is the effective date of the claim that has the largest amount of total settlement?

FROM Claims
JOIN Customers_Policies ON Claims.Claim_ID = Customers_Policies.Claim_ID
JOIN Available_Policies ON Customers_Policies.Policy_ID = Available_Policies.Policy_ID
JOIN Customers ON Customers_Policies.Customer_ID = Customers.Customer_ID
JOIN First_Notification_of_Loss ON Customers_Policies.Policy_ID = First_Notification_of_Loss.Policy_ID
WHERE Claims.Claim_ID IS NOT NULL
  AND Claims.Effective_Date IS NOT NULL
  AND Claims.Settlement_Amount IS NOT NULL
  AND Claims.Effective_Date > (SELECT MAX(Effective_Date) FROM Settlements)
ORDER BY Claims.Settlement_Amount DESC
